text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival. A 
once-a-year event held at Tracen Academy 
to show fan appreciation, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah, it's Tamamo Cross! It really is 
Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It really is her! *The* Tamamo Cross is 
right in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The" Tamamo Cross~?! Which "the" Tamamo 
Cross are ya talkin' about?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's fame grew by the day, and 
by now, she had gained quite a devoted 
fanbase.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They're makin' way too much of a fuss...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Trainer, somehow having "fans" 
just doesn't really click with me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"We ain't comedians, and we're not running 
just to entertain the fans, are we?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I just can't understand why 
they're cheerin' for me so hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross seemed unable to grasp the 
mindset of her fans.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try asking directly?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yer right. Maybe I'll ask the fans 
who come up to chat with me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, why do you root for me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Because Tamamo Cross-san is running her 
hardest for her family, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
For her mom, dad, and younger siblings. 
With that small body of hers.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, whaaat!? You even knew about that!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because she's featured in magazines 
and all over the internet. I want that 
Tamamo Cross to win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to be happy, no matter what. 
That's why!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so... Thanks a bunch... You sure 
know a whole lot about this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know ya feel for me, but at the end of 
the day, it's not your problem. Why're ya 
goin' this far...?

text_block_list.name: Scream from Afar
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what was that?! That voice just 
now... It came from inside the school 
building. What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rushing together toward the source of the 
scream...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: O-GUR-I! O-GUR-I!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's just Oguri standin' there. Hey, 
Oguri, did you mess somethin' up?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, I was just walking along. And then...

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap-san! Moving up from the regional 
circuit and taking consecutive graded 
stakes wins... You're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're not going to the Satsuki Sho? Where 
will you go next?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Why's even Oguri causin' such a huge 
fuss...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've only won two GIIIs, y'know? No matter 
how you look at it, it's gotta be crazy.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaa, Oguriーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not sure what's going on, but let's 
retreat for now! Oguri, Trainer, over 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Well, ain't this turned into a 
whole mess.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I knew the Twinkle Series was popular, but 
to think it was this huge of a deal...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I am surprised as well. I knew 
there would be more people here than in 
the regional areas, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the Twinkle Series was undeniably 
popular, the fever pitch surrounding 
Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap was on a whole 
other level.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing the fans' roaring enthusiasm 
today, what I felt was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? What do you mean 'something'... What 
is it?"
choice_data_list:
Something... this feels like a special 
moment...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross has her family, and Oguri Cap 
has the regional circuit to back them up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans seemed intensely drawn to it. So 
much so that they cheered with total 
abandon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I don't really get it, but if this hype 
keeps going, what's gonna happen to us?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can anyone even race while focusing like 
that? It's kind of terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's all right, Tama... Their cheers... 
give me courage."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Far from holding me back, they bring out 
my dormant power. That is why..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, if you say so after bein' 
so popular on the regional circuit, it 
must be true.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head back, Trainer.
choice_data_list: By "go back," you mean to the fans?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you're gonna lend us a hand, we 
shouldn't run away—we gotta face you 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do our best, Oguri. 
Fifty-fifty, yeah? We're on different 
paths anyway, so our fans won't overlap. 
Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap said nothing... Afterward, the 
two cheerfully devoted themselves to fan 
service.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where is this heat heading? In the 
sky—unprecedented clouds began to swirl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for the two upon their return was 
an unexpected order.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat—?! A talk show segment with just 
me and Oguri?!"

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there were so many voices pleading 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
They'd love to hear an interview between 
the two stars of the moment. It's short 
notice, but what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, there really are some 
eccentric folks out there. Trainer, is it 
really interestin' letting people hear the 
kind of chatter we usually do in the room?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, if you say so, I guess it's 
fine. Let's go, Oguri, get ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the impromptu talk show for the 
fans began, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, our room doesn't need an alarm 
clock."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've got a precise "stomach clock" every 
morning. When I get hungry in my sleep, it 
lets out a "gurgle" at the exact same 
time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A watch like that exists? That's 
amazing...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*Faceplants!* You're the one making that 
noise! Don't play dumb with me~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans were thrilled by their seamless 
banter. At that point, it felt less like a 
conversation and more like a stand-up 
comedy act.
